beats.text: The bookmark was a train ticket. 1999.
Abids Sunday book market. ₹40 for a worn copy of amma's favourite novel.
Page 112: a Vizag to Hyderabad ticket. 14 February 1999. Never used.
On the back, in appa's handwriting: "Didn't go. Stayed for her."
Amma sold her old books in 2001. This was her copy. She never knew the ticket was in it.
beats.small: Some love stories wait on page 112.
